title: Demiurge: Forging Navigable 4D Worlds via Autoregressive Video Rerendering
abstract: Recent advances in video diffusion enable novel-view video synthesis from a single input video, supporting world modeling, embodied intelligence, and robotic simulation. However, existing methods process camera trajectories independently, lacking the cross-trajectory consistency needed for coherent, navigable 4D worlds. We introduce Demiurge, an autoregressive video rerendering pipeline built on a dynamic 4D point-cloud memory cache. It promotes cross-trajectory consistency through four components: (1) an appearance video diffusion model that synthesizes photorealistic novel-view videos conditioned on the 4D memory; (2) a memory-consistent video depth completion model that aligns known-region depths with cached geometry and completes missing regions, mitigating scale ambiguity and discontinuities during memory updates; (3) memory-aware dual-stream warping that provides high-fidelity visual guidance and occlusion cues for novel-view synthesis; and (4) geometry-aware video refinement that enhances perceptual quality. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance and three key capabilities: coherent spatiotemporal lattice construction over dense multi-view trajectories; large-parallax video rerendering under challenging camera motions, including 180-degree rotations with no input-view overlap; and geometry-faithful outputs that can be directly optimized into high-quality 3D Gaussian Splatting representations with minimal artifacts. Project page: https://hanxinzhu-lab.github.io/demiurge_project_page/.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 exact version 2610.14685v1 的 52 页全文与关键图表核验。实验数字与比较均为作者报告，本项目未独立复现。代码状态：available。
analysis.ideaZh: Demiurge 以 time-indexed 4D point-cloud memory 连接多个目标 camera trajectories：先从 memory 渲染条件，再生成 RGB、补全并对齐 depth、回写 cache。appearance/geometry dual streams 分别防止颜色漂移与遮挡泄漏，作者报告多轨迹与后续 3DGS 一致性改善；这是离线的 plausible world completion，约五分钟/轨迹且 memory 会增长。
analysis.motivationZh: 独立生成的 camera-trajectory videos 缺少共同动态世界状态，难以维持跨轨迹 geometry、appearance 和 occlusion consistency。
analysis.methodZh: Demiurge 以 time-indexed 4D point-cloud memory 连接多个目标 camera trajectories：先从 memory 渲染条件，再生成 RGB、补全并对齐 depth、回写 cache。appearance/geometry dual streams 分别防止颜色漂移与遮挡泄漏，作者报告多轨迹与后续 3DGS 一致性改善；这是离线的 plausible world completion，约五分钟/轨迹且 memory 会增长。
methodFlow: 输入 monocular video、camera trajectory 初始化 4D point memory
dual-stream warping 产生 RGB/depth/visibility 条件
appearance video diffusion 补全新视角
cached-depth anchored video depth completion 与 Poisson refinement
按 provenance 更新 4D memory，继续下一条 trajectory
analysis.experimentsZh: Wan2.1-1.3B 各 diffusion stages，236k training clips；128 in-the-wild videos、14 fixed trajectories，81 frames、480×832。 以下结果为作者报告：作者报告 128×14 generated videos 上 FVD 334.518、View Sync64.893；由生成视频重建的 3DGS PSNR24.360、LPIPS0.237。（Tables 1-2, pp. 7-8） 对照范围：与 TrajCrafter、InSpatioWorld、ReCamMaster、Gen3C、Voyager、Spatia 比较；3DGS rendering consistency 是间接几何评估，非 dense ground truth recovery。 消融与诊断：Table 3 测 noise monitor、替换 monocular depth、dual streams 与 optional refinement；去 dual-stream 后 P-MSE 从 0.0010 升至 0.0049。
analysis.insightZh: 不再独立生成每个 novel-view video，而将新 appearance/geometry 持续合入显式 time-indexed world state；双 logical streams 共享观测但用不同 source masks。
analysis.evidenceZh: depth completion 用 cached metric depth 锚定已观测区域，再全局对齐与 Poisson refinement。（Sec. 3.2, p. 5）；appearance stream 只收新区域，geometry stream 使用全部有效观测，按 rendered depth conflict 选择。（Sec. 3.3, pp. 5-7; Fig. 2, p. 2）；作者报告 128×14 generated videos 上 FVD 334.518、View Sync64.893；由生成视频重建的 3DGS PSNR24.360、LPIPS0.237。（Tables 1-2, pp. 7-8）
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 显式 4D cache 把 video prior 转为可续建的世界表示，直接服务 generative 3D/4D scene assets。
analysis.caveatZh: 多模块串行约 5 分钟生成一条 target trajectory，难以交互。；重复点增加 storage/rendering cost；当前 representation 未压缩。；100 条轨迹 long-horizon claim 主要定性；细节由 diffusion 补全，不能称忠实重建 unseen surfaces。；公开仓库已确认 inference workflow 和 fine-tuned checkpoints，但未提供完整训练配方，本项目未独立复现。
